opus-mt-en-gmq.notes: opus-mt group model ('opus-mt-en-gmq-onnx' names a collection code 'gmq' on the target side: a language family, not a language). en -> the 6 languages its own vocabulary carries a >>xxx<< target token for; the token is mandatory and is applied automatically. The token set is the *target* side only - the encoder was trained on en alone.
